svg.title: Nocturne end-to-end architecture
svg.desc: A five-stage architecture showing collection, Snowflake ingestion, cost-gated AI analysis, deterministic verification and graph modeling, and the analyst console. Organization scope is preserved throughout.
svg.text: DARK-WEB EXPOSURE INTELLIGENCE · END-TO-END SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Cloud Scheduler starts the fleet crawl;
admins can also launch a scoped run.
the paid AI stages see it again.
cached AI runs only on new survivors
